name: Ruined temple
desc: a holy place the forest has taken back, good for discovery and for things left behind
tags: ruined stone temple, toppled columns, cracked steps, carved reliefs worn smooth, tree roots splitting the stonework, moss and lichen on fallen blocks, collapsed roof open to the sky, fallen column capital in the grass
prose: a ruined stone temple with toppled columns and cracked steps, carved reliefs worn smooth by weather, tree roots splitting the stonework, moss over the fallen blocks and a collapsed roof open to the sky
note: Comes back far too intact - a clean temple with a little moss on it. Ruin has to be built from breakage nouns: toppled columns, a fallen capital lying in the grass, roof open to sky. Roots and lichen do more work than the word 'ancient', which does none.
